portrait_format: RGB or RGBA, opaque background allowed
guidelines: Replace every PNG in this directory with real art using the exact same file names; the names are the contract. All images are 256x256 pixels. Portraits ({gender}_{mood}.png) may be opaque. Outfit overlays and decor icons must be RGBA with a fully transparent background so they layer cleanly over the portrait. Prefer a per-gender outfit overlay named outfit_{item}_{gender}.png; the client falls back to the gender-agnostic outfit_{item}.png when a per-gender file is missing. Align outfit overlays to the torso so the neckline sits just below the chin (around y=170 on a 256px canvas). Keep decor icons centered with generous transparent padding.
